name: Field Journal
label: Editorial journal
headline:
Take the long way.
Notice the details.
intro: An editorial space for small observations, walking notes and stories worth returning to.
records: The art of a slow morning
Leave a little room before the first task. Open a window, write down one observation and let the day begin without a hurry. This short sample is original editorial placeholder copy.
Draw a familiar route without looking at a map. Notice which corners, trees and thresholds remain. These small details tell a different story from a measured distance.
A notebook can hold sketches, questions and unfinished thoughts. Give each page a date, but leave room for an idea to change.
Choose a short route and a single thing to notice: doorways, shadows or signs of new growth. Return another day and compare your notes.
tool: Full article reading dialog, search and saved reading list

name: Plain Handbook
label: Documentation centre
headline:
Clear answers.
A better first step.
intro: A searchable handbook frontend that turns setup notes and everyday questions into an organised reading experience.
records: Unzip the source package. Open the project in your text editor. Use a local static server and open index.html. No dependency installation is required.
Import your source folder into a new Vercel project. Choose Other as the framework, leave the build command empty and use the project root as output. Replace sample content before publishing.
Open styles.css and update the variables at the beginning of the file. Keep text and background colours readable, and test both large and small viewports.
These frontend templates do not include a backend. Connect forms or payment services with server-side validation and keep all secret keys off the client.
tool: Searchable documentation, category navigation and expandable reading panels
